title: wolfCrypt FIPS errors translate to EIO instead of EACCES
description: In wolfssl_aes_cbc.c wolfssl_cbc_xlat_err() and equivalent functions in wolfssl_aes_gcm.c: the default case returns -EIO for unknown wolfCrypt errors. If wolfCrypt transitions to non-FIPS state between the outer fips_gate() check and the wc_* call, wolfCrypt returns a FIPS-specific error code (e.g., IN_CORE_FIPS_E = -1224 or similar). This maps to -EIO instead of -EACCES, violating the documented contract that FIPS failures return EACCES. Fix: add FIPS error codes to xlat_err() in all wolfssl providers (check wolfssl/wolfcrypt/error-crypt.h for the exact constants) and map them to -EACCES.
